intro.en: A bank account in detail, loans and mortgages, a first look at investing, and the tax return.

el plazo.en: the term; the instalment; the deadline

texto.en:
**The account.** You **abres una cuenta corriente**. Your salary **se ingresa** every month, you **retiras** or **sacas** dinero at **el cajero**, and you **haces una transferencia** to pay someone. What is left is **el saldo**. If it is negative, **estás en números rojos**. The bank **cobra comisiones**.

**Bills.** You **domicilias** los recibos de la luz y del agua, and they are paid automatically from the account.

**Borrowing.** You **pides** or **solicitas un préstamo**, **un crédito** or **una hipoteca**. The bank **lo concede** or **lo deniega**. You pay it back **en plazos**, at **un tipo de interés fijo** or **variable**. A debt is **una deuda**.

**Plazo** has three meanings: an instalment (pagar **a plazos**), a period (**a largo plazo**, **a corto plazo**) and a deadline (**el plazo termina** mañana).

**Investing.** **Invertir en** bolsa, **comprar acciones**, **ser accionista**. **La bolsa sube** or **baja**. The result is **ganancias** or **pérdidas**. **Ahorrar** and **los ahorros** are the safe side.

**Taxes.** Once a year you **haces la declaración de la renta** and present it to **Hacienda**. The result **sale a pagar** or **sale a devolver**. Not paying is **un delito fiscal**.

**Percentages** take an article: **un** tres por ciento; **el** veinte por ciento de los clientes.

frases.es: Durante años, Olga pensó que comprar un piso era cosa de otros, de gente con ahorros y sueldo fijo.
frases.en: For years, Olga thought that buying a flat was something for other people, for people with savings and a steady salary.
analisis: de gente con ahorros y sueldo fijo

frases.es: Ella trabajaba por cuenta propia y había meses en que su cuenta corriente estaba en números rojos.
frases.en: She was self-employed and there were months when her current account was in the red.

frases.es: Cuando por fin pidió una hipoteca, el primer banco se la denegó sin darle explicaciones.
frases.en: When she finally applied for a mortgage, the first bank turned her down without giving her any explanation.

frases.es: El segundo se la concedió, pero a un tipo de interés variable y a un plazo de treinta años.
frases.en: The second granted it, but at a variable interest rate and over a term of thirty years.
analisis: a un tipo de interés variable
a un plazo de treinta años

frases.es: Un amigo le había aconsejado que invirtiera sus ahorros en bolsa en lugar de comprar.
frases.en: A friend had advised her to invest her savings in the stock market instead of buying.

frases.es: Ella no se fiaba: había visto a su padre perder en un año las ganancias de diez.
frases.en: She did not trust it: she had seen her father lose ten years' profits in one.

frases.es: Hoy paga cada mes menos de lo que pagaba de alquiler, aunque reconoce que no dormirá tranquila hasta que bajen los intereses.
frases.en: Today she pays less each month than she used to pay in rent, although she admits she will not sleep easy until interest rates come down.
analisis: menos de lo que pagaba de alquiler

pregunta.en: According to the text, why did Olga doubt she could buy a flat?

She had an irregular income.en: Trabajaba por cuenta propia y a veces estaba en números rojos.

She preferred to rent.en: The text does not say that.

pregunta.en: According to the text, why didn't she invest in the stock market?

Her father had lost money there.en: Había visto a su padre perder las ganancias de diez años.

Her bank forbade it.en: The text does not say that.

domiciliado.en: Domiciliar un recibo: to pay it by direct debit.

pregunta.en: In a largo plazo, the word plazo means…

an instalment.en: That is in pagar a plazos.

bloques.frase: El banco le denegó el préstamo.

texto.en: The bank turned down his loan.
The bank denied having lent to him.
The bank gave him the loan.

explicacion.en: Denegar is the opposite of conceder.

bloques.frase: Este año la declaración me sale a devolver

traduccion.en: This year my tax return gives me a refund.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write an opinion text: is it better to rent or to take out a mortgage? Use your own country as the example.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Explain aloud to a young person how to manage their first salary: account, savings, debts and taxes.
